description: A natural landscape photograph depicts a wide, deep blue body of water, characteristic of a fjord or a substantial water course, extending into the distance between two chains of steep, rocky mountains or hills. The water appears calm and reflects the bright blue sky, which features scattered white cumulus clouds. In the foreground, the terrain consists of rugged grey rock formations interspersed with patches of green vegetation and scrub. The mountainsides bordering the water are steep and heavily forested in some areas, particularly on the right, while the left side shows more exposed rock. This image visually represents the type of geographical feature, such as estuaries or water courses, that is subject to classification in environmental land monitoring programmes like the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CORINE Land Cover (CLC) categories, specifically CLC 8.3.2 Estuaries or CLC 8.1 Water courses.
